arr_notify_pref_episodes_desc: Of series you follow or asked for, gathered into one message per series.
arr_notify_pref_declined: A request of mine was declined
arr_notify_pref_approved: A request of mine was OK'd
arr_notify_pref_auto_follow_desc: Your own requests are followed automatically. You can still stop following one.
arr_notify_pref_admin: Send admin alerts to my phone and e-mail
arr_notify_pref_admin_desc: New requests waiting for an OK, instances not answering, low disk, downloads that need a manual import, requests Seerr OK'd that no Sonarr/Radarr has, stuck downloads and reminders. They are always in the bell.
arr_notify_pref_toasts_desc: A short pop-up when something arrives (never while a video plays).
arr_notify_panel_phone_unavailable: Your administrator hasn't set up phone alerts.
arr_notify_panel_phone_none: Make up a private topic (or type your own), then subscribe to it in the ntfy app.
arr_notify_panel_phone_subscribe: In the ntfy app, subscribe on server {server} to the topic
arr_notify_panel_phone_by_admin: Your administrator set this topic for you.
arr_notify_pref_hide_titles: Hide titles on the lock screen
arr_notify_pref_hide_titles_desc: Phone alerts and e-mails say “Something you're waiting for is ready” instead of the title.
arr_notify_panel_email_unavailable: Your administrator hasn't set up e-mail.
arr_notify_panel_email_sent: We sent a 6-digit code. Enter it below.
arr_notify_panel_email_pending: Enter the code we sent to {address}:
arr_notify_panel_email_confirmed: Your address is confirmed. E-mail alerts are on.
arr_notify_pref_quiet: Hold phone alerts and e-mails during quiet hours
arr_notify_pref_quiet_desc: They are sent when quiet hours end (your device's time zone).
arr_notify_panel_test_sent: Sent. Check the bell (and your phone or e-mail).
arr_notify_err_invalid_topic: A topic needs 8 to 64 letters, digits, - or _.
arr_notify_err_invalid_address: That doesn't look like an e-mail address.
arr_notify_err_too_soon: Please wait a minute and try again.
arr_notify_err_too_many_today: That's enough codes for today. Try again tomorrow.
arr_notify_err_email_not_set_up: Your administrator hasn't set up e-mail.
arr_notify_err_send_failed: The e-mail couldn't be sent. Your administrator can see why.
arr_notify_err_no_pending_code: Ask for a new code first.
arr_notify_err_too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new one.
arr_notify_err_ntfy_topic_missing: Make up or type a topic first.
arr_admin_approved_not_in_arr: OK'd in Seerr {age} ago, but none of the Sonarr/Radarr Jellyfin Enhanced watches has it
arr_admin_approved_not_in_4k: 4K request OK'd in Seerr {age} ago, but none of the 4K Radarr Jellyfin Enhanced watches has it
arr_admin_approved_not_in_4k_series: 4K request OK'd in Seerr {age} ago, but none of the 4K Sonarr Jellyfin Enhanced watches has it
arr_ops_error: Couldn't load this tab. It tries again in a few seconds.
arr_ops_no_instances: No Sonarr or Radarr is set up.
arr_ops_code_approved_not_in_arr: OK'd in Seerr, not in Sonarr/Radarr
arr_ops_queue_expired: queue can't be read; last read {time}
arr_ops_keeps_partial: Keeps the partial download; delete it too?
arr_ops_group_missing_not_scanned: Imported; Jellyfin hasn't picked them up yet
arr_ops_group_missing_not_visible: Jellyfin can't see their files: check the path mappings (System → Path doctor)
arr_ops_group_missing_outside_library: No Jellyfin library contains their folders
arr_ops_group_approved: OK'd in Seerr, but none of the Sonarr/Radarr Jellyfin Enhanced watches has them
arr_ops_group_approved_4k: 4K requests OK'd in Seerr, but none of the 4K Radarr Jellyfin Enhanced watches has them
arr_ops_group_approved_4k_series: 4K requests OK'd in Seerr, but none of the 4K Sonarr Jellyfin Enhanced watches has them
arr_ops_stalled_sub: The download client reports no time left at {pct}%
arr_ops_missing_not_scanned: Imported to {path}; Jellyfin hasn't picked it up
arr_ops_missing_not_visible: Jellyfin can't see {path}: check the path mappings (System → Path doctor)
arr_ops_webhook_silent_sub: The webhook hasn't sent anything for a day, although {instance} imported files since
arr_ops_next_none: Nothing airs or comes out in the next 24 hours.
arr_ops_queue_truncated: The queue is longer than Jellyfin Enhanced reads; the oldest downloads aren't shown.
arr_history_no_match: No events match. Try other words or filters.
arr_history_coverage: {instance}: showing the newest {n} of {total} events, since {date}
arr_ops_seerr_truncated: Seerr holds {total} requests: the newest {n} are read; older ones keep what was last known of them.
arr_ops_seerr_incomplete: The latest read wasn't used ({reason}); the last complete one is shown and it is read again shortly.
arr_ops_bridge_on: Imports show in Jellyfin right away: {n} folder refreshes so far (imports and Scan now), {found} found their file
arr_ops_bridge_off: Imports wait for Jellyfin's own library scan ("Show imports in Jellyfin right away" is off)
arr_ops_missing_none: Everything Sonarr/Radarr imported recently is in Jellyfin.
arr_ops_missing_titles: {n} titles have files in Sonarr/Radarr but aren't in Jellyfin at all:
arr_ops_missing_titles_one: 1 title has files in Sonarr/Radarr but isn't in Jellyfin at all:
arr_ops_doctor_root_shared_root: Another instance has the same folder and neither maps it
arr_ops_doctor_root_roots_unknown: Another instance's folders can't be read yet, so it can't be told whether it uses this folder too
arr_ops_doctor_root_hidden: Users who aren't administrators don't see its upcoming titles on the Calendar (set a path mapping or link libraries)
arr_ops_doctor_no_mappings: No path mappings are set for this instance.
arr_ops_doctor_sample: {title}: expected at {expected}, Jellyfin has it at {actual}
arr_ops_doctor_suggestion: Suggested path mapping (Sonarr/Radarr tab → this instance → Path mappings): {arr} → {jellyfin}
arr_ops_refresh_library_root: new folder in a TV library: left to Jellyfin's library monitor
arr_ops_refresh_left_to_scan: new folder in a library without real-time monitoring: Jellyfin adds it at its next library scan (or use Scan now)
arr_ops_refresh_scan_running: skipped: a library scan was running
arr_ops_refresh_new_folder_refresh: new series: one metadata refresh asked of Jellyfin
arr_ops_refresh_switched_off: not run: switched off while it waited
arr_ops_settings_line: Thresholds: not in Jellyfin after {pending} min · low disk below {disk}% free · Seerr OK without Sonarr/Radarr after {grace} min
arr_ops_remove_body: Remove {title} from {instance}'s queue. The download stays in the download client: its data is kept.
arr_ops_remove_pack: This download covers {scope}; removing it affects all {n} episodes.
arr_ops_remove_blocklist: Blocklist this release (it won't be grabbed again)
arr_ops_delete_body: This removes {title} from {instance}'s queue and deletes what the download client has of it. Partial data can't be recovered.
arr_ops_delete_blocklist: The release is blocklisted, so it won't be grabbed again.
arr_ops_not_in_queue: That download is no longer in the queue.
arr_ops_queue_changing: The queue is changing; try again in a moment.
ddd_guarded_show: Content warnings (hidden by Spoiler Guard) — Show
